mapper.select: /*excelBuyerMdCmMyPunchoutSearch*/ SELECT ROWNUM SEQ, C.BUYER_ITEM_NO BUYER_ITEM_NO, C.BUYER_ITEM_NO BUYER_ITEM_NO2, A.DESCRIPTION DESCRIPTION_LOC, A.SPECIFICATION, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M001' AND CODE = C.ORIGIN_CODE) ORIGIN_NAME, C.MAKER_NAME, C.UNIT_MEASURE, A.UNIT_PRICE, B.CATEGORY_NO, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE C.AGENT = COM_CODE) AS AGENT, C.ITEM_NO, C.CUR, DECODE(C.ITEM_NO,NULL,'비재고','재고가능') AS GUBUN, B.DELIVERY_LT FROM DOOSCART A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.AGENT = C.AGENT AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND A.BUYER =#{st_com_code} AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.USE_FLAG = 'R' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY A.REG_DATE, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION
